diagnostic_findings: Cinearchives catalogue-path and archive-title heuristics over-predict archive_landing_page, including three human audiovisual_item pages; blocked AJAX filter endpoints are semantically search_or_index but were predicted unknown.

Cinememoire archive/fonds and structured-article heuristics confuse thematic/index surfaces, while repeated archive path context suppresses two genuine audiovisual_item pages and produces item-level false negatives.

EYE year-filter surfaces are not robustly recognized as search/index: most become unknown, the observation root becomes homepage, and two combined-year filters become false-positive audiovisual_item predictions.
Luce detail URLs are consistently recognized as item-level, but the fine class is item_record rather than the human audiovisual_item label for all seven detail pages.
Access-state inference agrees with the human reference on all 33 units, showing that access-state separation is functioning independently from semantic surface typing.

protocol_deviations.description: One of six preregistered entities produced no surfaces because its requested identifier was not present in CORPORA; the frozen 33-unit sample from five effective entities was retained without replacement.

scientific_decision: Protocol 2.0.0 is not validated for fine-grained M3 surface-type classification on this independent ecological sample. The binary item-level discriminator shows partial utility but recall is insufficient for scaling M4 without revision. Access-state separation is supported on this sample. Revise M3 in a new protocol version and validate again on a new frozen independent sample before operational scaling.
limitations: The independent ecological sample contains 33 units from five effective entities and is too small for broad generalisation.
The preregistered sixth identifier did not execute because it was absent from CORPORA, reducing entity coverage.
The sample was not designed to estimate prevalence of surface classes.
Several protocol classes have zero human support, so their per-class performance cannot be estimated from this sample.
Entity-specific clusters, especially the seven Luce detail pages, make aggregate binary metrics sensitive to within-entity repetition.
prohibited_interpretations: does not estimate corpus-wide prevalence of surface classes
does not validate protocol 2.0.0 for fine-grained surface typing
does not justify scaling M4 without revising M3 item-level recall
does not modify the official T2 baseline
does not establish any institutional or audiovisual-content AI claim
